quick_warnings: Wear reef-safe sunscreen only — the lagoon's stromatolites are ancient and extremely fragile.
Nearest major airport (Chetumal CTM) is ~40 min away; Cancún is a 4.5-hour drive.
Mosquitoes are heavy near the lagoon at dusk — bring repellent.

detail_guide.getting_around: Bacalar is a small town easily navigated on foot or by bicycle. Tuk-tuks and taxis cover the lakefront road. ADO buses connect to Chetumal and Cancún. Renting a kayak or hiring a boat is the best way to explore the lagoon.

top_sights.name: Laguna de Bacalar (Lake of Seven Colors)
top_sights.description: A stunning freshwater lagoon with layers of turquoise, blue, and indigo water stretching over 50 km.

top_sights.name: Fuerte de San Felipe
top_sights.description: An 18th-century Spanish fort overlooking the lagoon, now a small museum on piracy and colonial history.

top_sights.name: Cenote Azul
top_sights.description: A wide, deep cenote just south of town perfect for swimming and cliff jumping into crystal-clear water.

museums.name: Museo del Fuerte de San Felipe
museums.description: Inside the fort, exhibits cover the region's pirate history and Maya heritage.

parks.name: Canal de los Piratas
parks.description: A narrow channel with mangroves and vivid water colors; best explored by kayak or boat tour.

eat_drink_work.name: La Playita
eat_drink_work.description: Lakefront restaurant with docks and hammocks, serving fresh ceviche and regional dishes over the water.

eat_drink_work.name: Mango y Chile
eat_drink_work.description: Colorful cafe with healthy breakfasts, fresh juices, and a relaxed vibe popular with travelers.

quick_warnings: Usa solo protector solar biodegradable — los estromatolitos de la laguna son antiguos y extremadamente frágiles.
El aeropuerto más cercano (Chetumal CTM) está a ~40 min; Cancún queda a 4.5 horas en auto.
Los mosquitos son abundantes cerca de la laguna al atardecer — lleva repelente.

detail_guide.getting_around: Bacalar es un pueblo pequeño fácil de recorrer a pie o en bicicleta. Mototaxis y taxis cubren la carretera frente a la laguna. Los autobuses ADO conectan con Chetumal y Cancún. Rentar un kayak o contratar una lancha es la mejor forma de explorar la laguna.

top_sights.name: Laguna de Bacalar (Laguna de los Siete Colores)
top_sights.description: Una impresionante laguna de agua dulce con capas de agua turquesa, azul e índigo que se extiende por más de 50 km.

top_sights.name: Fuerte de San Felipe
top_sights.description: Un fuerte español del siglo XVIII con vista a la laguna, ahora un pequeño museo sobre piratería e historia colonial.

top_sights.name: Cenote Azul
top_sights.description: Un cenote amplio y profundo al sur del pueblo, perfecto para nadar y saltar desde las rocas al agua cristalina.

museums.name: Museo del Fuerte de San Felipe
museums.description: Dentro del fuerte, las exhibiciones cubren la historia pirata de la región y el patrimonio maya.
